name: Being Persecuted
overview: Scripture teaches that being persecuted for righteousness and for the name of Christ is a mark of blessing and a pathway to salvation, as those who endure such trials are promised the kingdom of heaven and ultimate salvation (Matthew 5:10; Matthew 10:22; Mark 13:13). Believers are called not only to expect hatred and false accusations but also to respond with love, blessing, and prayer for their persecutors, reflecting Christ's own example (Matthew 5:11, 5:44; Luke 6:22). This enduring faith in the face of opposition confirms the believer's commitment to Christ and assures them of God's favor.
